ITEM.PTXT: The multi-information display, master warning indicator light illumination and CRUISE operation/warning indicator light blinking return to the system control status display when the conditions in the table below are met according to the display content.

INDICATE.TITLE: Radar Cruise Control System Warning Display Return Conditions

ENTRY.PTXT: When it is determined that there is no longer dirt on the front of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly or the radar-transmissive grille cover
When the windshield wiper switch assembly is operated from HI to INT, LO or OFF after the weather improves
When no malfunction is detected after the engine switch (IG) is turned OFF, the engine is restarted and the set operation is performed again (radar cruise control system ON)
